q01.question: What are the core retail jewellery brands operated by Titan Company Limited in India?
q01.answer: Titan Company Limited operates several core retail jewellery brands in India, including Tanishq, Zoya, Mia by Tanishq, and CaratLane [https://alphastreet.com/india/titan-company-indias-most-trusted-jewelers]. These brands cater to diverse consumer segments, ranging from mass-market to luxury [https://trendlyne.com/equity/about/1403/TITAN/titan-company-ltd].

q02.answer: The available sources did not establish the exact total number of net new jewellery stores added by Titan Company across its entire retail network in FY 2023-24. q03.answer: As of the end of FY 2023-24, Titan Company operated 464 Tanishq stores across 270 towns [https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/titan-company-to-expand-jewellery-market-share-grow-emerging-businesses-11717313255735.html]. Regarding CaratLane, the company operated 272 stores at the time of reporting for that fiscal period [https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/TITAN_31052024112612_SEinvestorpresentation2024.pdf]. The available sources did not establish the specific total retail store count for Mia by Tanishq at the end of FY 2023-24, though it is noted that 140 Mia stores were added over the three-year period leading up to that time [https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/titan-company-to-expand-jewellery-market-share-grow-emerging-businesses-11717313255735.html].

q07.question: What is the total showroom count of Kalyan Jewellers, and why do published reports show conflicting numbers between 250 and over 290 showrooms?
q07.answer: As of March 31, 2026, Kalyan Jewellers reported a total showroom network of 507 locations, comprising 466 showrooms in India (including Candere) and 41 international showrooms [https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/quarterly-results/FY%202025-2026/Earnings%20Presentation%202026/Investor%20PresentationQ4_signed.pdf]. The discrepancy in reported figures—such as the range between 250 and 290—stems from variations in reporting periods, the inclusion or exclusion of specific sub-brands like Candere, and the distinction between standalone Kalyan-branded stores and the broader group network [https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/quarterly-results/FY%202025-2026/Earnings%20Presentation%202026/Investor%20PresentationQ4_signed.pdf, https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/quarterly-results/FY%202024-2025/Earnings%20Presentation%202025/q4-Investor%20Presentation.pdf]. For instance, reports from FY25 identified 278 standalone Kalyan showrooms in India alongside 73 Candere outlets, totaling 351 showrooms in India [https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/quarterly-results/FY%202024-2025/Earnings%20Presentation%202025/q4-Investor%20Presentation.pdf].

claims.text: As of March 31, 2026, Kalyan Jewellers reported a total showroom network of 507 locations, including 466 in India and 41 internationally.
